description: Resumable tracker for polishing unified-tracking and shipping v3.1.0. The FIRST phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. Never restart from scratch; never redo 'complete' work.

userDecisions.dependencyScope: Update ALL deps to latest STABLE (patch+minor+major incl. TypeScript 6, ESLint 10, jsdom 29, lint-staged 17). Hold a package back ONLY with a documented blocker in runHistory.
userDecisions.release: User pre-authorized NPM publish ('release that on NPM and let me know'). Do npm publish --dry-run + report contents BEFORE the real publish. Publish is the final phase 05 step.
userDecisions.nativeProviders: DECISION 2026-05-26: 'Web-first, native planned'. KEEP ios/+android/ scaffolding; docs must state tracking runs via the web/JS layer (incl. Capacitor WebView) and native SDK bridges are planned/not-yet-implemented. Do NOT implement the 18 native SDKs this release; do NOT remove native dirs.
userDecisions.tests: No NEW automated tests (global rule). Running existing tests = gate; fixing tests broken by our changes = allowed; un-skipping/expanding coverage only if it fixes a real source bug.
userDecisions.packageManager: yarn only for installs; npm only for the publish step.
userDecisions.logger: No direct console.* in src/ outside src/utils/logger.ts.
userDecisions.commits: ONE commit per session/phase; push after commit.

knownRisks: ESLint 10 vs @ionic/eslint-config@0.4.0 peer compatibility — may block; mitigation in phase01.4.
TypeScript 6.0 new strictness / removed deprecated flags may surface type errors / tsconfig changes.
esbuild 0.28 (0.x minor = breaking-ish) may affect Rollup TS transform.
jsdom 29 may change test DOM behavior (localStorage/matchMedia mocks).
Publishing is irreversible — gate behind full verification + dry-run.
verificationGate: yarn type-check && yarn build && yarn test && yarn lint  (all must be clean)

baseline.kickoffGate: type-check PASS, build PASS, test 268 pass/2 skip (after experimentalDecorators fix), lint 0 err / 636 warn + prettier drift
baseline.baselineBugFixed: tsconfig.json was missing experimentalDecorators:true. Code uses legacy class decorators (@RegisterProvider). A recent in-range tooling bump made vitest's esbuild transform emit bare @decorator syntax that Node can't parse -> 9 of 11 test files failed with 'Invalid or unexpected token'. Added experimentalDecorators:true -> esbuild now downlevels to __decorate -> 268 tests pass.

runHistory.summary: Explored codebase (65 ts files, 16 providers, web+native), ran npm outdated (17 pkgs incl 4 majors), invoked skills (analytics-tracking, nodejs-best-practices, security-review). Created plan folder, overview, 5 phase specs, and this tracker.

All deps -> latest stable. Fixed 3 real issues found en route: (1) missing experimentalDecorators broke 9 test files under new esbuild; (2) TS6 deprecated baseUrl removed; (3) ESLint 10 needed @eslint/js + --ext + dead @ionic/eslint-config + eslint-plugin-import removed, eslint-config-prettier+globals declared. peerDeps widened to Capacitor 8. Gate: type-check+build+test(268/2skip)+eslint all green; clean warning-free install.

Deep audit via 2 parallel agents (security; functionality/quality/gap) + verification. Wrote phase02-findings.md (~25 findings, FIX/DOC/DEFER). No CRIT/HIGH security vulns. Key: privacy controls inert (PRIVACY-01), no consent gate (CONSENT-01), dead EventQueue/React-API/web.ts, native iOS+Android are stubs+unbridged (DOC). Populated phase03 with 9 fix batches.

Tier-1 fixes: logger to workspace std (default warn, redact(), eslint-disable) + SECRET-01 redaction; PRIVACY-01 excludedProperties stripping in dispatch; CONSENT-01 consent gate + opt-in non-essential defaults + scoped re-enable; TYPE-SENTRY removed from analytics union+autodetect; WARNINGS-INIT surfaced in InitializeResult. Gate: type-check+build+test(268/2skip)+eslint(0 err) green.

Security hardening: VALID-02 (deepMerge proto-pollution guard), VALID-01 (core input guards warn+no-op), SCRIPT-01 (matomo trackerUrl http(s) validation; GA/segment id/key encodeURIComponent), XSS-01 (heap eval() -> plain JS). Cleanups: removed harmful postinstall; reworded stale comments + catch bindings in providers/index.ts. Gate green (268/2skip, 0 eslint errors). REMAINING phase03: 3.5 dead subsystems (web.ts/React/EventQueue), 3.7 Firebase-base, 3.8 rest, 3.9 type-tightening.

resumeInstructions: 1) Read this tracker. 2) Find the first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' (currently phase03.5 + remainder of 3.8; then 3.7, 3.9 -> phase04 docs -> phase05 release; read phase02-findings.md for the issue list). 3) Read that phase's spec .md. 4) Invoke matching skills per RULE #0. 5) Do the work, run the verification gate (yarn type-check && yarn build && yarn test && yarn eslint), mark sub-task 'complete', append a runHistory row, bump lastUpdated. 6) ONE commit per session per the commit rule. 7) NEVER redo complete work or restart planning.
